tasks.short: Design upgrades such as roofs and rainwater systems.

steps.what: Choose natural lighting, green roofs or rainwater collection.
Draft upgrades for the existing buildings.

loop.input: systems the architect chose, such as lighting, a roof or rainwater
loop.output: an upgrade note that uses only those systems
loop.check: a system that was not chosen is discarded
loop.why_not_simpler: whether the existing building can take the upgrade is the design

steps.what: File the upgrade the architect designed.

tasks.design: The architect chooses the systems, such as natural lighting, a green roof or rainwater collection. A note may use only those systems. Designing the environmentally sound structural upgrade for the existing building stays the architect. {PROJECT} files that design. The draft does not decide that the building can take it.
tasks.previous_blocker: Upgrades were drawn as options with no record of why one was refused.
tasks.enabler_now: A chosen system can be restated. Whether the building can take it cannot.
tasks.still_hard: A structure that cannot carry the upgrade, or a system the client did not ask for, stays the design.
tasks.human_edge: The architect knows what the existing building will and will not accept.
tasks.altitude: Restating the chosen systems takes less rewriting. Choosing them and designing the upgrade stay.

reach.task: Read the filed upgrade and what was refused

evidence.claim: A note that repeats chosen systems is a draft. Designing a structural upgrade is not.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: the architect designs the upgrade. An engineer's check of the structure is a different task and is not replaced here.
Structured input: system id, building id. Producer is the architect. A system that was not chosen is not in the note.
Design time stays. The draft does not claim the building can take the load.
unknowns: Which of these systems does the office actually design?
research_questions: How often is an upgrade drawn and then refused by the existing structure?

already_counted.description: Designing the upgrade is already the remaining time on that step.

incremental.description: Retire drafts when the chosen systems change.

approvals.approved_version: upgrade the architect designed for that building

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If no system is chosen, the draft is empty and the architect still inspects what the building can take. Provisional.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Inspect proposed sites for construction suitability.

steps.what: Open the records for the proposed site.

tasks.design: Records already held for the proposed site open first. Inspecting the building site stays on the ground. Suitability for construction is the architect's determination. A record is not a site visit, and it does not declare the site suitable.
tasks.previous_blocker: Suitability was a feeling after a walk, with the constraints still in someone's head.
tasks.enabler_now: A stored record can be opened. Suitability cannot.
tasks.still_hard: A constraint the records omit, or a site that cannot be walked, stays the inspection.
tasks.human_edge: The architect sees a site that looks clear and is still unsuitable.
tasks.altitude: Opening known records takes less searching. The inspection and the suitability decision stay.

reach.task: Read the suitability and what was not walked

evidence.claim: Opening a stored site record is a query. Inspecting a site is not.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: the architect inspects and determines suitability for this brief. A ground investigation by another profession is a different task.
Structured input: site id, constraint, suitability. Producer is the store for known records and the architect for the determination. A site that was not walked is not marked suitable.
Inspection time stays. The record does not fill a constraint that was not seen.
unknowns: Which site records are already indexed?
research_questions: How often is a site called suitable before anyone walks it?

already_counted.description: The site inspection is already the remaining time on that step.

incremental.description: Retire suitability notes when the brief changes.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If no records are indexed, the inspection is unchanged and the determination still follows the walk. Provisional.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Design with environmentally friendly practices and standards.

steps.what: Design structures that incorporate environmentally friendly practices.
List stored credits the design might meet.
Decide concepts against leadership and environmental standards.

tasks.design: Designing structures that incorporate environmentally friendly practices stays the architect. A stored credit list can show items the design might meet, including leadership and environmental standards named in the brief. The architect decides which concepts to keep. The list is not a certification.
tasks.previous_blocker: Friendly practices were claimed in the brief and checked against a paper credit list at the end.
tasks.enabler_now: A credit written as a checklist item can be listed. Whether the design earns it cannot.
tasks.still_hard: A credit the design only nearly meets, or a standard the office is not pursuing, stays a decision.
tasks.human_edge: The architect knows which concept is in the design and which is only a claim.
tasks.altitude: Listing stored credits takes less ticking. The design and the decision stay. Nothing is certified here.

evidence.claim: Matching a design note to a stored credit item is a list. Certification is not this task.
The source pack does not make this office the certifier. A credit list is not an award of a rating.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: the architect designs and decides which concepts to pursue. Certification by a named scheme is a different task.
Structured input: credit id, design element id, pursued or not. Producer is the credit list and the architect. A credit is not marked met by the list.
Design time stays. The list does not add a practice the design does not have.
unknowns: Is the credit list stored as items?
Is this project actually pursuing that standard?
research_questions: How often is a credit claimed before the design contains it?

already_counted.description: Designing the practices into the structure is already the remaining time on that step.

incremental.description: Retire credit comparisons when the design revision changes.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If there is no stored credit list, the comparison is empty and the architect still designs. Provisional.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Perform feasibility and environmental impact studies.

steps.what: Collect the site facts already on file.
Draft a study that cites only those facts.

loop.input: site facts already on file, each with an id
loop.output: a study that cites only those ids
loop.check: a statement that does not cite a fact id is discarded
loop.stop: one draft; a missing fact is marked not found
loop.why_not_simpler: feasibility and environmental impact are the architect's judgement

steps.what: Perform feasibility and environmental impact studies.

tasks.design: Site facts already on file are collected. A predesign draft may cite only those facts. The architect performs the feasibility and environmental impact judgement. {PROJECT} files that note. A missing fact is shown as not found. The draft does not conclude.
tasks.previous_blocker: Studies were written from memory of the site, and a constraint was discovered later.
tasks.enabler_now: A stored fact can be cited. Feasibility cannot.
tasks.still_hard: A fact the file does not hold, or an impact the facts do not settle, stays the study.
tasks.human_edge: The architect knows which gap makes the project not feasible.
tasks.altitude: Collecting stored facts takes less hunting. The feasibility and impact judgement stay.

reach.task: Read the finding and the facts that were missing

evidence.claim: A draft that cites stored facts is a pack. The source pack describes research as an answer with citations. The finding stays a judgement, not a measured case here.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: the architect performs this predesign study. A formal environmental assessment by another profession is a different task.
Structured input: fact id, site id, finding. Producer is the file for the fact and the architect for the finding. A sentence with no fact id is discarded.
The judgement is remaining time. A gap is not filled with a plausible fact.
unknowns: Who else must sign an impact study?
research_questions: How often does a feasibility note omit a constraint that was already on file?

already_counted.description: The feasibility judgement is already the remaining time on that step.

incremental.description: Retire drafts when the site facts change.

approvals.approved_version: finding the architect made for that predesign study

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If site facts are not indexed, the draft is empty and the architect still performs the study from what they can gather. Provisional.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Upgrades and site inspections stay with the architect. A credit list is not a certification. A predesign study cites facts that exist, and the feasibility judgement is the architect's.
reach: The client sees which upgrade was refused.
A study shows the facts that were not found.
skills_to_grow: Do not claim a credit the design does not contain.
Do not call a site suitable before it is walked.
role.ambitious_version: An upgrade the existing building cannot take is filed as refused, and a missing site fact is not replaced with a plausible one.
